# Embedded Comfy inference core

Copied from Comfy-Org/ComfyUI commit b0f4b7b294ce482a2e071d9d762c133d38c7aa07,
the validated Floyd Headliner Animate core. Contains comfy, comfy_api,
comfy_execution, utils, nodes_custom_sampler, and required Python entry helpers.
No server.py, main.py, browser frontend, manager, or external ComfyUI installation.
Upstream GPLv3 license is retained in LICENSE.
